key_idea: Books are independent: for each choice of vertical side that fits under H, the best width is the smaller of the other two sides.
sketch: For each book try the three sides as the vertical one; if it is <= H the candidate width is the min of the remaining two; take the minimum candidate and sum. If any book has no side <= H print impossible. O(n). Pitfall: the sum reaches 1e14, so use 64-bit.
